summary: The filing reports an unregistered sale of equity securities (limited liability company interests) by PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Co LLC to third-party investors for cash, with aggregate consideration of approximately $44.8 million across multiple classes (Anchor I, Anchor I-B, Anchor II, E Shares, Standard A). The shares were sold under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Regulation D/S. Additionally, the filing discloses net asset values per share as of May 31, 2026 (ranging from $10.27 to $10.36) and declares monthly distributions payable on July 20, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising and periodic reporting event with no special-situation characteristics such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
